profile.name: Aleesha Bhatti
profile.badge: Mechanical Engineering & Biomedical Engineering Minor | Columbia University
intro: I'm a Mechanical Engineering undergrad with a Biomedical Engineering minor at Columbia University who loves building hardware from scratch—from CAD models and rocket launches to embedded C++ microcontrollers and medical device prototypes.

When I'm not in the machine shop or troubleshooting circuits, I'm super passionate about social equity and civic advocacy! Outside of engineering, you can find me exploring cute cafes in search of the best matcha, weightlifting, going on long walks, and taking way too many photos (I am constantly out of phone storage) 📸✨.

experience.role: Research Intern — Neural Signal Acquisition Lab
bullets: Installed, calibrated, and operated data acquisition (DAQ) hardware across a 150-participant study, validating sensor-level signal quality prior to data release.
Developed Python and MATLAB processing pipelines to filter, segment, and extract features from test data, reducing turnaround time on diagnosing bad runs.
Authored test documentation and standardized the team's data-collection procedure, improving repeatability and co-authoring a methods manuscript.
CADed the nose cone and fin assembly end-to-end in SolidWorks for team launch vehicles.
Collaborated in the machine shop to fabricate, integrate, and test parts directly on the rocket airframe.
Conducted hardware technical diligence on 20 early-stage hardware companies, evaluating design maturity and production readiness.
Narrowed the startup evaluation field down to 6 finalists presented directly to internal stakeholders.
Soldered electrical assemblies, resolved wiring and mechanical interference issues, and performed precision inspections to verify components met drawing tolerances.
Conducted root cause analysis on recurring assembly and design defects, implementing engineering changes that improved build reliability and reduced assembly time.
Created and revised SolidWorks and AutoCAD models and production drawings to support design changes and component fit during production ramp-up.

projects.title: Rocket Design & Launch Fabrication
projects.summary: Engineered nose cone and fin geometries in SolidWorks, combining laser-cut structural bulkheads and 3D-printed fairings for launch stability.
projects.subtitle: SolidWorks | 3D Printing | Laser Cutting | Aerodynamics & Flight Stability
projects.overview: This project involved designing, modeling, and fabricating a functional multi-stage high-stability rocket built from the ground up to achieve maximum flight altitude and controlled descent recovery.

highlights.title: Aerodynamic Surface Modeling
highlights.text: Generated von Kármán nose cone profiles and swept fin geometries in SolidWorks to minimize atmospheric drag and keep the Center of Pressure (CP) strictly behind the Center of Gravity (CG) during flight.

highlights.title: CAD & Tolerance Design
highlights.text: Designed inter-stage coupler rings, payload bays, and motor retainer clips in CAD with tight fit tolerances to account for material thermal expansion during launch ignition.

highlights.title: Additive & Subtractive Fabrication
highlights.text: Precision laser-cut interior mounting bulkheads and 3D-printed lightweight PETG nose sections to handle high kinetic impact upon landing.

highlights.title: Hardware Integration & Flight Tests
highlights.text: Hand-assembled launch rail buttons, shock cords, and recovery deployment systems, running ground ejection tests to ensure reliable parachute deployment.

projects.title: Deviated Septum Correction Device
projects.summary: Designed a nitinol shape-memory frame encapsulated in silicone, evaluating structural recovery and biomechanical contact pressure.
projects.subtitle: Nitinol Shape-Memory Alloy | Silicone Molding | Biocompatible Prototyping
projects.overview: Designed a non-surgical proof-of-concept medical device for deviated nasal septum correction utilizing thermally activated shape-memory alloys embedded within soft elastomeric casings.

highlights.title: Shape-Memory Alloy Integration
highlights.text: Configured heat-treated Nitinol wire structures programmed to activate at human body temperature, providing controlled and continuous outward spring tension against nasal cartilage.

highlights.title: 3D Mold Design & Silicone Casting
highlights.text: Modeled custom negative molds in SolidWorks and poured dual-component biocompatible silicone to fully encapsulate the metal frame and prevent soft tissue abrasion.

highlights.title: Mechanical Force Testing
highlights.text: Evaluated physical revisions under compression setups, verifying that outward mechanical forces stayed within safe biomechanical parameters for patient comfort.

highlights.title: Hardware Iteration
highlights.text: Refined mold tolerances and wire gauge configurations across multiple test prints to maximize structural memory recovery and ergonomic fit.

projects.title: Truss Bridge Design & Structural FEA
projects.summary: Designed and load-tested an optimized member geometry truss bridge, validating FEA stress points against destructive failure modes.
projects.subtitle: Structural Mechanics | Finite Element Analysis | Destructive Testing
projects.overview: Executed full structural design, FEA stress modeling, and physical destructive load testing for a high-efficiency truss bridge optimized for load-to-weight performance.

highlights.title: Hand Calculations & Joint Analysis
highlights.text: Analyzed member tension and compression forces using the method of joints and sections to determine ideal truss geometry and strut dimensions.

highlights.title: SolidWorks Simulation (FEA)
highlights.text: Conducted static linear stress analyses and buckling simulations in SolidWorks FEA to locate peak stress concentrations and eliminate unnecessary material weight.

highlights.title: Precision Construction
highlights.text: Machined structural members and assembled joints with rigid gusset plates to ensure accurate transfer of vertical static forces straight to support abutments.

highlights.title: Empirical Destructive Testing
highlights.text: Loaded the physical bridge to failure on a hydraulic load frame, correlating physical fracture points directly against FEA predictions to validate calculations.

projects.title: Automated Cardiovascular Heart Stent
projects.summary: Modeled an expandable mesh stent structure in SolidWorks, using finite element analysis to ensure fatigue resistance and smooth vascular flow.
projects.subtitle: Cardiovascular Engineering | Cyclic Fatigue FEA | Medical Device Design
projects.overview: Engineered an expandable mesh cardiovascular stent system engineered to alleviate arterial stenosis and hypertension while maintaining high radial strength and long-term fatigue resistance.

highlights.title: Parametric Strut CAD Geometry
highlights.text: Modeled repeating balloon-expandable mesh struts in SolidWorks, balancing outer radial expansion ratio with minimal axial foreshortening.

highlights.title: Non-Linear FEA Fatigue Analysis
highlights.text: Performed non-linear material stress simulations to evaluate plastic deformation during deployment and verify structural fatigue limits under cyclic hemodynamic pressure.

highlights.title: Fluid Dynamics & Hemodynamics
highlights.text: Optimized inner surface profiles to reduce fluid recirculation and wall shear stress, helping minimize blood turbulence and thrombosis risks.

highlights.title: Medical Design Compliance
highlights.text: Applied medical device design rules to maintain continuous outer wall contact without inducing arterial wall puncture or excessive inflammation.

projects.title: CO₂ Pressurized Wooden Dragster
projects.summary: Precision-machined a low-drag wooden chassis with custom axle channels and brass bushings for high-acceleration CO₂ track runs.
projects.subtitle: Aerodynamic Mass Reduction | Precision Machining | Track Testing
projects.overview: Designed, machined, and aerodynamically refined a low-mass wooden dragster engineered to achieve peak acceleration on a guided track using pressurized CO₂ cartridge thrust.

highlights.title: Chassis Shaping & Drag Reduction
highlights.text: Shaped a balsa wood chassis to minimize frontal cross-sectional area and reduce turbulent air drag along the rear pressure chamber.

highlights.title: Precision Machining & Lathe Work
highlights.text: Machined custom brass bushings and turned lightweight aluminum axles on a lathe to guarantee low friction and straight-line tracking.

highlights.title: Weight Distribution & Center of Mass
highlights.text: Drilled internal weight-reduction pockets around non-structural areas, balancing chassis mass directly over the rear wheels to maximize initial traction.

highlights.title: High-Speed Track Trials
highlights.text: Measured race performance using optical timer sensors, adjusting wheel alignment tolerances to eliminate wobble and drag during top-speed runs.

projects.title: Thermodynamic Phase-Change Surface Model
projects.summary: Constructed a 3D thermodynamic state surface of water in CAD and 3D printed the physical model to illustrate liquid-solid-vapor boundaries.
projects.subtitle: Thermodynamics | CAD Surface Modeling | 3D Printing & Slicing
projects.overview: Constructed a physical, 3D mathematical representation of water's thermodynamic state surface (P-V-T) to visually and tactitly demonstrate phase boundaries across solid, liquid, and vapor regions.

highlights.title: Mathematical Surface Extraction
highlights.text: Converted thermodynamic state equations and empirical phase diagram data points into a continuous 3D surface mesh inside CAD.

highlights.title: Phase Boundary Feature Mapping
highlights.text: Extruded physical ridges along the sublimation, melting, and vaporization lines, highlighting the triple point and critical point for clear visual analysis.

highlights.title: Additive Manufacturing & Slicing
highlights.text: Optimized print orientation, layer heights, and support structures in Ultimaker Cura to ensure smooth surface slopes without steep overhang defects.

highlights.title: Technical Report & Presentation
highlights.text: Authored an accompanying technical thermodynamics report detailing state function derivations and phase transition properties mapped on the model.

projects.title: Dual-Game Arduino Handheld Console
projects.summary: Hand-soldered an ATmega microcontroller system running custom C++ games inside a custom laser-cut acrylic and wooden enclosure.
projects.subtitle: Arduino (C++) | Hardware Wiring | Circuit Soldering | Laser Cutting
projects.overview: Designed and built an integrated handheld arcade console powered by an ATmega microcontroller, featuring custom game code written in C++ and a hand-soldered hardware platform.

highlights.title: Embedded C++ Software Logic
highlights.text: Programmed real-time rendering, collision detection algorithms, score state tracking, and button debouncing routines for two playable arcade games.

highlights.title: Circuit Soldering & Hardware Wiring
highlights.text: Wired OLED displays, tactile pushbuttons, piezo speakers, and power management circuits cleanly onto breadboard prototyping shields.

highlights.title: Ergonomic Enclosure Design
highlights.text: Modeled a multi-layered snap-fit acrylic and wooden casing with laser-cut button cutouts, mounting points, and battery access slots.

highlights.title: Debugging & Power Optimization
highlights.text: Diagnostic tested signal connections with a multimeter to resolve voltage drop issues and optimize battery efficiency during extended play.

projects.title: Automated Temperature Sensor & Audio System
projects.summary: Built a thermistor-based environmental monitor featuring a drill-pressed and 3D-printed housing with automated acoustic and visual alerts.
projects.subtitle: Analog Sensing | Drill Press Operations | Embedded Logic | 3D Printing
projects.overview: Engineered an automated environmental monitoring device that processes real-time ambient temperature data to trigger dynamic audio-visual alerts upon crossing safety thresholds.

highlights.title: Analog Signal Conditioning
highlights.text: Integrated NTC thermistor sensor circuits with voltage divider networks and calibrated mathematical lookup tables for precise temperature reading.

highlights.title: Acoustic & Visual Feedback Circuits
highlights.text: Hand-soldered RGB LED indicator rings and piezo buzzers, coding custom tone frequencies and color changes corresponding to thermal zones.

highlights.title: Machine Shop Enclosure Fabrication
highlights.text: Designed and 3D-printed a robust chassis, utilizing a drill press to precision-bore mounting holes for switches, power jacks, and sensor probes.

highlights.title: Embedded Threshold Logic
highlights.text: Wrote C++ conditional logic on a microcontroller to automatically trigger thermal warnings and eliminate false positive readings from electrical noise.
